source.citation: Liu et al., Long-lived remote ion-ion entanglement for scalable quantum repeaters, Nature 652, 51-57 (2026), Fig. 4 and Supplementary Sec. B.3
source.parameter_location: 10 km DI-QKD run: alpha=2.3%, S=2.5758(59), QBER=0.0360(6), valid-data rate 0.291/s
source.mapping_status: the two measured DI observables determine Vzz and the sum entering the fixed CHSH geometry; Vyy=Vxx completes a positive Bell-diagonal effective transcript state

validity.route_scope: one demonstrated immediately measured link; not a stored or swapped repeater-chain state

hardware.resource_semantics: one calcium-40 ion per node; measurements follow each herald

rate_model.rate_semantics: long-run valid DI-QKD data accumulation rate, not the alpha=17% storage-link rate

state_model.correlation_source: Vzz=1-2Q and Vxx=S/sqrt(2)-Vzz for Liu's published fixed XZ-plane settings
state_model.completion_semantics: effective post-measurement Bell-diagonal transcript completion with Vyy=Vxx; it reproduces the reported CHSH and key-basis QBER but is not full tomography

counterfactual_axis_optimization.semantics: Alice remains on Z/X; Bob axes are proportional to Vzz*Z plus_or_minus Vxx*X. The published 45-degree axes remain the validation default.

storage_decoherence_model.semantics: immediate-measurement DI transcript anchor; storage extrapolation is forbidden

memory_model.decay_semantics: not applicable to the immediately measured DI transcript anchor

histogram_adapter.optical_stack_semantics: all source, link, detector, rotation, and readout errors are already aggregated in the observed effective DI transcript state and must not be applied twice

notes: This is a demonstrated one-link Bell-test/transcript anchor, not a finite-key security implementation and not a storage profile. Authentication, information reconciliation, privacy amplification, and composable finite-key accounting remain outside the histogram backend.
